// scripts: Excluded deliberately. tsc infers rootDir as the common ancestor of every input file, so a single .ts under scripts/ drags the inferred root up from src/ to the project root — silently relocating the entry point from dist/main.js to dist/src/main.js and breaking `start:prod` (node dist/main) and the Docker CMD with it. Nothing under scripts/ needs compiling: both are one-off manual utilities run in place (npm run backfill:keycloak-attributes goes through ts-node, generate:openapi is plain .js).
